tickets.title: Project layout setting and the Board layout
tickets.what:
`.scratch/project-layouts/spec.md` (the setting, the Board column, the consistency rules);
design `docs/design/project-ux/` direction B.

acceptance.text: Settings → Panel → Project layout: Timeline | Board | Inbox (Inbox may render as Timeline until ticket 02), `projectLayout` in hud-settings, default Timeline, applied live like `panelLayout`.
Board hub: milestone map rows (cell per slice, `n/m`, age; `+N` when the row is full), `latest` line, one legend row, In flight, page rows as gauges; Split list and preview, and Classic.
Board Progress: the current milestone open into its slices in cell order (to-try slices as ID + brief sentence), older milestones as map rows, jobs outside the ledger, Next.
Board Control plane: one chain row per role; the selected role's places in the preview (Split) / under it on Enter (Classic); all place keys work there as today.
Board Projects list: one table row per project.

Consistency rules 1–6 of the spec hold; EN/ZH strings; docs/reference.md; unit tests (40 columns EN and ZH: rows exactly 40 wide, no mid-word cut, counts equal Timeline's, place keys work from Board's preview); snapshots.

accepted.verdict: accepted by the owner; see STATE ledger

tickets.title: The Inbox layout
tickets.what:
`.scratch/project-layouts/spec.md` (the Inbox column, the consistency rules); design
`docs/design/project-ux/` direction C.

acceptance.text: Inbox hub: Needs you ranked (questions and STATE's waiting items, then to-try slices newest first, tickets asking for an answer, blocked slices, roles at their limit), the reason as one word on the right; header figures as spec rule 1; Running; `last accepted` line; page rows. Split list and preview, and Classic.
Inbox Progress: To try (every milestone, newest first, ID + brief sentence), Blocked, Working, Next, Done folded to one row.
Inbox Projects list: groups Needs you / Running / Quiet (a quiet project is one row).
Control plane and Tickets as Timeline's.
Consistency rules 1–6 of the spec hold; EN/ZH strings; docs/reference.md; unit tests (40 columns EN and ZH, counts equal Timeline's, `Space`/`y`/`n` on Inbox to-try rows); snapshots.

accepted.verdict: accepted by the owner; see STATE ledger
